title: Stefan-Boltzmann Law
notes: **Law statement:** the total radiant energy emitted per unit area of a black body per unit time is proportional to the fourth power of its absolute temperature: $E = \sigma T^4$.
**For real bodies:** $E = e\sigma T^4$, where $e$ is the emissivity ($0 < e < 1$).
**Net radiation:** if a body at temperature $T$ is surrounded by an enclosure at $T_0$, the net power radiated is $P_{net} = e\sigma A(T^4 - T_0^4)$.
**Why fourth power matters:** a small increase in temperature causes a huge increase in radiated power. Doubling $T$ increases $E$ by a factor of 16.
